name: forms-customer-intake
title: Onboarding · Customer intake
description: Onboarding · Customer intake. Blocks/Forms pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/blocks/Forms and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in block built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:g-udi/design-system. Demo assets referenced (supply your own or copy them into public/): /avatars/person-07.svg, /avatars/person-20.svg, /avatars/person-24.svg, /avatars/person-41.svg, /avatars/person-50.svg.
